description:
Search the UI reference catalog by design problem and keyword. Every screen is tagged on four
facets: task (what the person is doing), pattern (screen archetype), component (building blocks)
and state (empty, filtered, error...). Filter by any of them; commas mean OR within a facet and
different facets combine with AND, e.g. pattern=list-view,table-view and state=empty. Tags accept
ids, labels or aliases ("kanban", "zero state"); listTags shows the vocabulary.

q matches titles, tags, visual style (dark, serif, editorial, gradient, playful, pastel...), notes,
page sections and observed actions; every word must match, or the closest partial matches come back
with partial=true. Filter by product, kind or scope too.

Use this to find design pattern examples like empty states, pricing pages, kanban boards,
onboarding steps, settings or create forms. Results carry each screen's tags; refine lists the
most common other tags among the results so you can narrow down. Pass a result's id to
getScreenImage to see it, or findRelatedScreens for the same problem in other products.

When the user wants screens combined, or a brief or spec built from several references, call
buildRecipe with the chosen screen ids.

component.description: Building blocks on the screen, comma-separated for any of them, e.g. modal, date-picker, comparison-table.

kind.description: Only return this kind of screen.

pattern.description: Screen archetype, comma-separated for any of them, e.g. pricing-page, list-view, board-view, settings.

product.description: Only return screens from this product id, e.g. linear, stripe, airbnb.

q.description: Keywords to match, e.g. "pricing page", "empty state", "dark settings", "serif editorial landing". Omit to list everything that matches the filters.

scope.description: Only screens from collections with this capture scope.

state.description: Data or interaction state, comma-separated for any of them, e.g. empty, first-run, filtered, error.

task.description: What the person is trying to do, comma-separated for any of them, e.g. create, choose-plan, invite.

name: search_screens

filters.description: The tag filters applied, as tag ids per facet.

next.description: What to do with the results

notes.description: Tags that were moved to the facet they belong to, e.g. "empty" passed as a pattern.

partial.description: True when no screen matched every word and these match most of them.

refine.description: The most common other tags among all results, per facet, to narrow the search.

kind.description: flow is an onboarding step, marketing a public web page, product an in-app screen.

previewUrl.description: Screen-sized preview (the top of long pages). Present on pick options and related screens.

productName.description: Present on pick options and related screens.

scope.description:
What was captured. marketing: logged-out marketing pages only. public-demo: logged out, but real
product surfaces or public demos were used. task-incomplete: signed in, but the journey stops before
its result. signed-in: signed in, and the journey reaches its result.

style.description: What the screen looks like, judged from its first viewport (tags/style-spec.md). Searchable through q.

accentHue.description: The accent hue of buttons and highlights, or none.

aesthetic.description: One or two of minimal, editorial, playful, technical, glassy, bold, warm, data-dense, retro, corporate.

caption.description: What makes the screen look the way it does.

imagery.description: One or two of none, product-ui, photography, illustration, 3d, icons-only, charts.

tags.description: Design-problem tags. The first pattern is the primary one. See listTags.

title: Search screens
